class: A record of a past event (a stored alert, a held rule row) that is worded or stored with figures read at a later moment: the figure and the event no longer belong together, so the text can contradict the record's own numbers.
mechanism: The sentence or the stored field fell back to the latest check's value, threshold or limit instead of the sample that confirmed the event, and a held ladder row stored no rung of its own. Second instance (2026-11-17, #709 item 7): the record's first timeline entry WAS a write-once snapshot, but the writer filled it from the GateContext of the check that processed the candle close (background.py set _gate_ctx before alert_gate.step closed an earlier check's pending sample), so eight fields came from one check too late; the shape is 'right storage, wrong moment', not missing storage.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX screen walk-through, strategy 149 trade page (test-data copy), then code review of commits 870a3170..871d0baa
first_seen.evidence: Screen: 'Profit before charges -Rs 2,275.00 reached your target of 50%' (a loss that 'reached' a target; the held sentence used the live loss). Review (Sonnet, Tier B): background.py stored limit from the latest check; a Held row for a ladder rule stored threshold None (restore_held then could not end the hold by the band). Opus Tier A confirmed the in-branch regression was fixed in 15967796.

fix: Held target sentence uses the record's own figures and the user's stored target (5eac813a, 13649f51); a stored yes/no alert keeps the confirming sample's value, threshold and limit (871d0baa); a held ladder row keeps its rung (15967796). 2026-11-17: the confirming check travels with the sample (alert_gate RuleSpec/Opened/Held carry it; background.record_fields reads only e.sample; GateBatch/apply lost ctx); the check screen's held flag is worded only from its stored record (branch fix/record-fields-confirming-sample, 4bc6dc59, 775953a9, b0a3bfa0, 5194c75b).

detection.note: Guarded for every record field and the held flag (2026-11-17): mutations 'gate closes with the newest sample', 'fields from the writer's strategy' and 'worker attaches no sample' each fail a test (Opus Tier A review + fix round). Not guarded: records stored before 2026-11-17 keep their later-check figures (no sample to restore); the clock alert's time (T-10b, #709 item 8) is still not stored.
